2 Handed Kettlebell Swing中文名称：项目 AI 译稿，尚未人工核对Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, the kettlebell on the floor about 20-30 cm in front of your toes.

Hinge at the hips with a slight bend in the knees and a flat back, and grip the handle with both hands.

Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward explosively so that it swings forward and up to chest or shoulder height (Russian style, not overhead). Your arms stay straight and relaxed, the power comes from the hips.

Bench Press中文名称：沿用历史目录名称，未作新增专业审定Lay down on a bench, the bar should be directly above your eyes, the knees are somewhat angled and the feet are firmly on the floor. Concentrate, breath deeply and grab the bar more than shoulder wide. Bring it slowly down till it briefly touches your chest at the height of your nipples. Push the bar up.

If you train with a high weight it is advisable to have a spotter that can help you up if you can't lift the weight on your own.

With the width of the grip you can also control which part of the chest is trained more:


wide grip: outer chest muscles

narrow grip: inner chest muscles and triceps来源分类与社区说明仅用于动作导航；不代表教材核对或刺激权重。暂无动作示范：来源没有此动作的图片或视频。
